stem_book: The function f(x) = [x] (greatest integer function) is defined for all real x. Which of the following describes its range? (a) All positive integers (b) All real numbers (c) All integers (d) All non-negative integers
key: c Z (the set of all integers)
work: [x] takes every integer value n on [n, n+1) and nothing else ⇒ range = Z
